name: YTD gross revenue and bill count
desc: Indian FY YTD (Apr–Mar) — single KPI row. APP_REPORT MrpValue + XnNo.
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS YTDSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(
    CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 END,
    4, 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

name: QTD gross revenue
desc: Current Indian FY quarter total sales — APP_REPORT.
sql:
SELECT
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS QTDSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= CASE
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (4,5,6)    THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 4,  1)
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (7,8,9)    THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 7,  1)
    WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (10,11,12) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 10, 1)
    ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1)
  END
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

name: Yesterday gross revenue by branch
desc: All branches ranked for prior calendar day.
sql:
SELECT
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

name: Daily gross revenue trend this month
desc: One row per day in current month — line chart.
sql:
SELECT
  CAST([XnDt] AS date) AS SaleDate,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY CAST([XnDt] AS date)
ORDER BY SaleDate

name: Top 10 articles by gross revenue this month
desc: Rank by MrpValue (not qty) — APP_REPORT ArticleNo.
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [ArticleNo] AS Article,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [ArticleNo]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

name: Top 10 salespersons by units sold this month
desc: SalesPersonName on SLS_DATA_WITHOUT_ITEMID — units not revenue.
sql:
SELECT TOP (10)
  ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST([SalesPersonName] AS NVARCHAR(200)))), ''), '(Unknown)') AS StaffName,
  SUM(ISNULL([SalesQuantity], 0)) AS Units,
  SUM(ISNULL([SalesNetAmount], 0)) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_DATA_WITHOUT_ITEMID WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([CashmemoDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([CashmemoDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM([SalesPersonName])), '') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST([SalesPersonName] AS NVARCHAR(200)))), ''), '(Unknown)')
HAVING SUM(ISNULL([SalesQuantity], 0)) > 0
ORDER BY Units DESC

name: Top 10 vendors by purchase quantity this month
desc: PurQty on PUR_REPORT — different from purchase amount ranking.
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
  [SupplierName] AS Vendor,
  SUM(ISNULL([PurQty], 0)) AS TotalQty
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([PurchaseDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([PurchaseDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [SupplierName]
HAVING SUM(ISNULL([PurQty], 0)) > 0
ORDER BY TotalQty DESC

name: Gross revenue by all branches this month
desc: Full branch list (not TOP 10) for export / scan.
sql:
SELECT
  [BranchAlias] AS Branch,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [BranchAlias]
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

name: Last 30 days gross revenue by day
sql:
SELECT
  CAST([XnDt] AS date) AS SaleDate,
  SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -29, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
  AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY CAST([XnDt] AS date)
ORDER BY SaleDate

name: MTD purchase returns by vendor
sql:
SELECT TOP 15
  [SupplierName] AS Vendor,
  SUM(ISNULL([PrtQty], 0)) AS ReturnQty
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PRT_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE CAST([PurReturnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND CAST([PurReturnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY [SupplierName]
HAVING SUM(ISNULL([PrtQty], 0)) > 0
ORDER BY ReturnQty DESC
